cda.spendInfo.en: What TikTok charged for Studio's ads in the period (TikTok's days, the ad account's time zone). All = since each ad started.
cda.spendInfo.zh: 该时段内 TikTok 为 Studio 投放的广告收取的费用（按 TikTok 的日期，广告账户时区）。全部 = 自每条广告开始投放起。

cda.impressionsInfo.en: How many times TikTok showed the ads.
cda.impressionsInfo.zh: TikTok 展示这些广告的次数。

cda.ctrInfo.en: Clicks ÷ impressions: of the times the ad was shown, how often someone tapped through to crazydramas.
cda.ctrInfo.zh: 点击 ÷ 展示：广告每被展示一次，有人点进 crazydramas 的比例。

cda.hold2Info.en: Of the plays, the share still watching after 2 seconds (TikTok's 2-second views ÷ plays). Plays are the times the video started on someone's screen.
cda.hold2Info.zh: 播放中，2 秒后仍在观看的比例（TikTok 的 2 秒观看 ÷ 播放）。播放 = 视频在某人屏幕上开始播放的次数。

cda.hold6Info.en: Of the plays, the share still watching after 6 seconds (TikTok's 6-second views ÷ plays).
cda.hold6Info.zh: 播放中，6 秒后仍在观看的比例（TikTok 的 6 秒观看 ÷ 播放）。

cda.p25Info.en: Of the plays, the share that watched at least a quarter of the video.
cda.p25Info.zh: 播放中，至少看完视频四分之一的比例。

cda.p100Info.en: Of the plays, the share that watched the whole video.
cda.p100Info.zh: 播放中，看完整条视频的比例。

cda.avgInfo.en: How long a play lasted on average, in seconds (TikTok's average play time, weighted by each ad's plays).
cda.avgInfo.zh: 每次播放平均持续的秒数（TikTok 的平均播放时长，按每条广告的播放次数加权）。

cda.checkoutsInfo.en: TikTok's conversions for the event each campaign optimizes: checkouts started on most of our campaigns, purchases on the ones that optimize purchases, none on Traffic campaigns. TikTok's own count (7-day click, 1-day view), not crazydramas'.
cda.checkoutsInfo.zh: TikTok 按各广告系列优化事件统计的转化：我们多数广告系列是发起结账，优化购买的系列是购买，流量系列没有。这是 TikTok 自己的统计（点击后 7 天、浏览后 1 天），不是 crazydramas 的。

cda.per1kInfo.zh: 每 1,000 次展示带来的结账数。

cda.tableSubPeriod.zh: 该时段内展示过的 {n} 条广告

cda.bench.zh: 展示 500 次以上广告的中位数

cda.benchInfo.en: The middle value of each column among the ads TikTok showed at least 500 times. A number at least 20% better than it is green, at least 20% worse is red. Early ads are never marked.
cda.benchInfo.zh: 在 TikTok 展示至少 500 次的广告中，每一列的中间值。比它好至少 20% 的数字标绿，差至少 20% 的标红。早期广告不标记。

cda.earlyInfo.en: Under 500 impressions: too few to judge yet.
cda.earlyInfo.zh: 展示不足 500 次：数据太少，暂不评判。

cda.hidden.en: {n} more ads had no impressions in this period.
cda.hidden.zh: 另有 {n} 条广告在该时段内没有展示。

cda.hiddenAll.zh: 另有 {n} 条广告从未展示。

cda.none.en: No TikTok ad was shown in this period.
cda.none.zh: 该时段内没有 TikTok 广告展示。

cda.failed.en: TikTok did not answer for ad account {id}: {error} Its ads show –.
cda.failed.zh: TikTok 未返回广告账户 {id} 的数据：{error} 其广告显示为 –。

clipsPosting.tiktok.info.en: Every TikTok ad this clip ran as, added up: times shown, clicks ÷ times shown, the share of plays still watching at 6 seconds, and TikTok's checkouts. Empty for a clip never launched.
clipsPosting.tiktok.info.zh: 该片段投放过的所有 TikTok 广告合计：展示次数、点击 ÷ 展示、6 秒时仍在看的播放比例，以及 TikTok 统计的结账数。从未投放的片段为空。

clipsPosting.tiktok.failed.zh: 无法获取 TikTok 数据：{error}

mad.videoHint.en: At 2 s / At 6 s: of the plays, the share still watching after 2 and 6 seconds. Avg play: seconds per play. Read with the ad's numbers; — until the Monitor reads them again.
mad.videoHint.zh: 2 秒 / 6 秒：播放中 2 秒和 6 秒后仍在观看的比例。平均播放：每次播放的秒数。与广告数据一同读取；Monitor 再次读取前显示 —。
